definition: Officially approved as an SBI chapter. Approval gives your team access to training and an assigned local service area.
SBI's central student support team. These students approve chapters, train new leaders, answer project questions, and review finished work.
The student who starts and leads a local chapter, organizes the team, communicates with businesses, and stays in contact with SBI's student support team.
Team role responsible for building client websites using AI. No coding experience required.
Team role that shoots raw footage for client promo videos.
Team role that edits the raw footage from the Cameraman into a finished promo video.
Optional team role that guides video production and editing with marketing techniques to maximize reach.
A student support role that checks finished chapter work before a business receives it.
A student support role that answers applicant questions and reviews chapter applications.
A student support role that helps an approved chapter get set up, understand its responsibilities, and choose businesses to contact first.
A student support role that chapter leaders contact when they need help during a project.
The local service area assigned to an approved chapter. Work for businesses inside this area must be free.
Losing official chapter status after missing the two-project monthly target for three months in a row. Chapter leaders should contact the student support team before that happens.
